description: Every field a call to tour may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

defaultsKey.description: the UserDefaults key the first run is kept under (key.welcomed, key.finished); tour when left out

imports.description: modules the views import, such as the one the mark's view or a look name is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Components/Tour when left out

launch.description: `destination = state` for a `-destination` launch argument: welcome, tips(<tab>), done, about, or about(<page number or name>); any other destination opens with the first run done

look.description: `role = Swift` for a colour or a font, like `accent = Color.accent`; a bare name is Color.name or Font.name, and aboutDesign is serif, rounded, monospaced or default: accent, onAccent, scrim, welcomeTitle, welcomeBody, welcomeButton, welcomeSkip, tipTitle, tipCounter, tipBody, tipButton, aboutDesign, aboutTitle, aboutSubtitle, aboutButton, pageTitle, pageTagline, pageBody, pageRow

mark.description: the app's mark on the welcome card and the pager's cover: a view expression like `AppMark()` (`{size}` in it is the size it is drawn at), or an SF Symbol's name; sparkles when left out

pages.description: one line a feature page, after the cover: `symbol | palette | name | tagline | description | row | row …`, each row `symbol: text`; an empty palette takes the cover's

palettes.description: one line a palette the pager's gradient drifts through: `name: #RRGGBB #RRGGBB …`, two to eight colours, the first its base

parts.description: the parts to write, all three when left out: welcome (a card over a scrim the first time the tabs are up), tips (each tab's tips, one card at a time, the first time that tab is up), about (the about pager over a drifting gradient)

prefix.description: the types' prefix, Tour when left out: `Kit` writes KitLayer, KitAbout and the modifier .kit(tab:)

strings.description: `key = "text"` for any word the tour shows (a `\n` breaks the line): welcome.title, welcome.body, welcome.start, welcome.skip, tip.counter, tip.next, tip.done, tip.back, about.name, about.title, about.subtitle, about.begin, about.close, about.back, about.next, about.done; tip.counter holds {n} and {count}

tips.description: one line a tip, in tour order: `tab: title | body | symbol | place`; tab is the name the app passes for the tab that is up, symbol an SF Symbol, place leading (under the bar's leading control, the default; or topLeading), trailing (or topTrailing), bottomLeading, bottomTrailing or center

tuning.description: `key = value` for a timing (`spring(0.4, 0.8)`, `easeOut(0.2)`), a number or a symbol: mark.turn, welcome.show, welcome.skip, welcome.settle, welcome.mark, welcome.inset, welcome.radius, scrim.opacity, tip.step, tip.settle, tip.swap, tip.scale, tip.width, tip.top, tip.side, tip.bottom, about.begin, about.step, about.blend, about.cover, about.mark, about.markRadius, gradient.speed, gradient.start, gradient.hold, gradient.strength, gradient.reach, gradient.drift, gradient.opacity, symbol.back, symbol.forward, symbol.finish, symbol.close, symbol.begin, symbol.row

title: What tour takes (craft-agent/1)
